evidence: It was demonstrated that ZrO thin films can be grown in the ZrCl -based atomic layer deposition process at substrate24 temperatures of 180–600 8C. The films grown on silicon and silica substrates were amorphous or polycrystalline dependently on the growth temperature and film thickness. Crystalline films grown at 180–210 8C contained a cubic phase of ZrO . Tetragonal2 ZrO was the main crystalline phase in the films that were 10–50 nm in thickness and were deposited at 300–600 8C. In thicker2 films, grown at 300–600 8C, the monoclinic phase appeared and started to dominate with the further increase of film thickness.
